system.description:
Fixer. +1 Talent Die when fixing or constructing mechanical objects.

Curious (Flaw). When you hear a peculiar noise or see an unopened chest or door, you must pass a CR 2 Smarts Check to resist investigating blindly.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.86
